data.name: Parasited Will
data.detailed_description:
PARASITED WILL: The Legacy of the Dark Age

THE AWAKENING OF CHAOS

Two centuries ago, the sky broke. Fragments of an unknown origin rained down upon Earth, carrying a pathogen that defied all known logic. Those who approached the impact zones became "Patient Zero," the source of a plague that did not merely consume sanity but rewrote the very structure of human society. Rampant violence and erratic behavior reigned for decades, plunging the world into a Dark Age from which humanity is only just beginning to emerge.

THE NEW ORDER: THE ANTI-CHAOS BRIGADE

Two hundred years after the fall, the Anti-Chaos Brigade stands as the last bastion of civilization. Utilizing forbidden bioengineering knowledge and technology recovered from the ancient craters, the Brigade fights to rebuild a consumed world. Yet, they are not alone: hordes of grotesque mutants, descendants of the first infected, lurk in the shadows, while the Impact Fanatics—cultists who worship the catastrophe as a divine gift—seek to hinder humanity’s progress at all costs

OPERATION: REINFORCED HEARTS

Facing the imminent threat of total extinction, the Brigade has activated its most drastic protocol: "Reinforced Hearts." The most formidable warriors from the few remaining human settlements are subjected to a radical experimental intervention. Only those who survive the process become Potentiated Humans, the combat elite capable of resisting the parasite's influence and facing the horrors that dominate the wildlands.

OUR WARRIORS

Take command and embody one of the few capable of balancing the scales between extinction and freedom:

  • Sasha (The Northern Tempest): A Nordic warrior whose precision with firearms is legendary. In a world where every bullet is a treasure, her coldness and discipline make her the ultimate weapon.

  • Fahd (The Desert Bulwark): A master of hand-to-hand combat. His raw strength and refined technique allow him to shatter enemy defenses when his fist meets mutated flesh. No one survives within his reach.

  • Kimiko (The Sentinel of Japan): Trained in the ancient canons of discipline from her homeland, Kimiko is a warrior whose tactical versatility is unrivaled. Expert in both short-range weaponry and long-range bow shooting, her feline agility allows her to maneuver through the most lethal impact zones.

GAME MODES

PvP - Duel of Honor: Prove your worth and supremacy within the ranks of the Anti-Chaos Brigade.

PvE - The Path of Survival: Immerse yourself in the narrative of Parasited Will. Traverse devastated zones, unravel the secrets of the virus, and hunt for the necessary resources to strengthen your Hero against the horror lurking in the shadows.

PvE Local Coop - Blood Alliance: Experience the full campaign locally with a friend. Share the loot, split the danger, and unravel the secrets of the virus by working as a team. Two perspectives, one single goal: survive absolute horror. (PvE Local Coop mode is unlocked after completing Quest 7: The Air Threat)

data.short_description: Enter this story of survival against the new alien domain with the help of the warriors of the Anti-Chaos Brigade in intense, fast-paced Arcade-style combat.

English*, Spanish - Latin America, French, Italian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 3100 / Ryzen 3 1200 / 2200G / Intel Core i3-10100F / i3-9100F
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 570 / RX 6400
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Ryzen 5 5500 / Intel Core i5-10400F / Core i3-12100F
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT (8GB) / Radeon RX 580 (8GB) / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 (6GB) / GTX 1060 (6GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
